components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: High-contrast action button linking to playground or external source.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #f0f6fc; color: #0b0d10; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 12px 18px; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s ease, opacity 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); opacity: 0.9; } .ds-arrow { font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Outline Badge
components.description: Monospace technical status label and pass tag.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid #2a313c; border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 9px; color: #8b949e; font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; background: transparent; }

components.name: Inspector Card
components.description: Dark container for shader parameters and live controls.
components.html:
Renderer passes
Three-pass WebGPU execution
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid #2a313c; border-radius: 16px; background: #12151a; padding: 20px; color: #f0f6fc; font-family: sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 13px; color: #8b949e; }

narrative.overview: The design system presents the animated border-beam component as a high-precision graphic instrument. The interface combines dark technical inspection aesthetics with clean shadcn/ui components, demonstrating real-time WebGPU execution, three-pass WGSL shader rendering (Stroke, Inner, Bloom), and responsive CSS masking.
keyCharacteristics: Dark technical surfaces with monospace status telemetry and live inspection cards.
Live WebGPU execution highlighted with green and blue status badges.
Clean component composition without redundant decorative borders.
Monospace readouts and badges for parameters, shader names, and metrics.

rules.name: The One Color Master Rule
rules.body: The component's animated color field carries all chromatic energy; surrounding controls and layout remain monochrome so the beam itself commands attention.

dos: Do compose all page elements using official shadcn primitives (Button, Card, Badge, Separator, Tabs, Slider, ToggleGroup, Label).
Do provide clear feedback when copying install or playground code.
Do preserve the live 3-pass vgpu rendering execution on every active beam.
donts: Don't add raw colorful backgrounds to container cards that compete with the border-beam color field.
Don't use custom space-y-* or space-x-* classes; use gap-* in flex/grid containers.
Don't remove the WebGPU fallback mechanism.
